1) A bidirectional RNN with GRUs combined with an attention mechanism can be successfully applied for author profiling tasks.

(1) Bidirectional Recurrent Neural Networks with GRUs combined with an Attention mechanism are a good baseline for the Author Profile Shared Task at PAN.
